name: Plausible
description: Plausible is a lightweight, privacy-first, GDPR-compliant web analytics platform built by Plausible Insights OÜ in Estonia. With no cookies and no personal data collection, it delivers actionable traffic insights through a clean dashboard while remaining fully open-source and self-hostable.
